name: Second overdue notice
subject: Second notice: overdue library items
about: The second overdue notice; firmer. Koha has no ODUE2 by default: create it in Notices and slips, then choose it in the triggers. Sent by overdue_notices.pl when the overdue trigger for the patron's category (Tools → Overdue notice/status triggers) names this code. One message lists every item in that stage. The fines lines appear only when Koha has charged a fine on a listed item, and the restriction line only when the account is restricted.

cases.name: restricted
expect: account is restricted at the moment
